paragraphs.text: Warthog is an obsolete creature type that represents a type of pig that lives in open or semi-open habitats, often in quite arid regions, and have prominent tusks on their face.

Warthog debuted as a creature type on Warthog from Visions . In Judgment , Giant Warthog was released with the beast type instead. With the release of Coldsnap , Warthog was give errata to be a beast so that the two cards matched. Shortly after in the Magic Online release of Visions they were once again given errata to be boar type instead with Giant Warthog becoming a Boar Beast.
